screen.watchlist.title: Watchlist
screen.watchlist.description: Live bid/ask with two-minute sparklines; picks the shared symbol when linked.
screen.chart.title: Chart
screen.chart.description: Candles built by the engines from live quotes.
screen.order-ticket.title: Order ticket
screen.order-ticket.description: Buy or sell the linked symbol; risk checks run before the venue sees it.
screen.orders.title: Orders
screen.orders.description: Every order this session, with fills, status, reason, amend, and cancel.
screen.account.title: Account
screen.account.description: Cash and positions as the venue reports them, with live P&L.
screen.price-board.title: Price board
screen.price-board.description: Every listed instrument with three levels of depth, the last match, and the day's range, coloured against reference, ceiling and floor.
screen.time-and-sales.title: Time & sales
screen.time-and-sales.description: Every trade in the linked symbol, newest first, coloured against reference, ceiling and floor.
screen.depth-ladder.title: Depth ladder
screen.depth-ladder.description: Every tradable price of the linked symbol with the book's sizes; a click fills the ticket.
screen.conditional-orders.title: Conditional orders
screen.conditional-orders.description: Stops, take-profits and trailing stops this terminal holds, each sent as an order when a trade reaches it.

hotkey.notShared: Your shortcuts were saved, but could not be passed on: {error}
hotkey.intro: Shortcuts work anywhere in the terminal, even while you type in a field. They are F-keys or combinations with Ctrl or Alt.
hotkey.needsModifier: {key} belongs to fields and buttons. Use an F-key, or hold Ctrl or Alt.
hotkey.confirmCancelAll: Press again within 2 seconds to cancel every working order.

venue.title: Choose a market
venue.intro: The terminal trades on the market you choose. Each one brings its own rules: lot sizes, price steps, sessions, and order types.
venue.later: You can change it later from File › Market; the terminal restarts on the new one.
about.tagline: An open-source trading terminal: one core for every broker, each connected through an adapter of its own.
trading.notice.active: Trading resumed: orders go out as risk allows.
trading.notice.reducing: Reduce only: only orders that close a position go out. Working orders stay.
trading.notice.halted: Trading halted: new orders and amendments are refused. Working orders stay; Trade › Cancel every working order cancels them.
app.dayHint: Net of {costs} in commission and sell tax, from this terminal's trades today and the venue's positions.
app.dayPartial: Some instrument's price is not known yet, so it is left out.
conditional.marketableHint.band: at the day's floor to sell, its ceiling to buy
conditional.placed: #{id} held; it is sent when a trade reaches it
conditional.lifetime: Held in this terminal while it runs: closing or restarting it drops them.
conditional.when.at_or_below: when a trade is at or below {price}
conditional.when.at_or_above: when a trade is at or above {price}
conditional.blocked: Held back: {reason}. It tries again on the next trade.
ticket.risk.title: Size by risk
ticket.risk.sized: Size {quantity} risks {atRisk} at the stop ({loss} each, costs included)
ticket.risk.none: {budget} does not cover the smallest order at this stop ({loss} each)
ticket.exits.title: Stop, target and size
ticket.sentWithExits: #{id} {side} {quantity} {symbol} sent; its exits wait for its fills
journal.restored: Today's journal brought the session back: {orders} orders, {held} conditional orders.
journal.restoredUnconfirmed: Today's journal brought the session back: {orders} orders, {held} conditional orders. {unconfirmed} open orders are not confirmed: this venue cannot report on them, so check them where the account is held.
journal.damaged: Some lines of the journal could not be read and were set aside, in {path}; everything else was restored.
journal.failed: The journal could not be opened: {error}. This session will not come back after a restart.
journal.writeFailed: The journal could not be written: {error}. What changed since may not come back after a restart.
order.unconfirmedReason: Restored after a restart; the venue has not confirmed it since.
conditional.lifetimeKept: Kept in this terminal across restarts, so a restart brings them back; they work only while it runs.
journal.damagedUnconfirmed: Some lines of the journal could not be read and were set aside, in {path}; everything else was restored. {unconfirmed} open orders are not confirmed: this venue cannot report on them, so check them where the account is held.
order.placedElsewhere: Placed elsewhere: in the broker's app or another program.
order.unansweredReason: The venue has not answered; the terminal has asked it where this order stands.
ticket.halted: {symbol} is halted. The venue takes no orders for it until it resumes.
ticket.haltedWhy: {symbol} is halted: {reason}. The venue takes no orders for it until it resumes.
ticket.haltedQueued: {symbol} is halted. The venue holds new orders until it resumes.
ticket.haltedQueuedWhy: {symbol} is halted: {reason}. The venue holds new orders until it resumes.
ticket.suspended: {symbol} is suspended. The venue takes no orders for it.
ticket.suspendedWhy: {symbol} is suspended: {reason}. The venue takes no orders for it.
ticket.suspendedQueued: {symbol} is suspended. The venue holds new orders until it trades again.
ticket.suspendedQueuedWhy: {symbol} is suspended: {reason}. The venue holds new orders until it trades again.
ticket.shortRestricted: Short sales in {symbol} are restricted: a sell beyond your holding needs a limit price.
about.report: Attach the log from this folder: one file a day, the last week kept. It names orders and connections and says what happened, with no account number. Prices and figures appear only where a reason names them.
about.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the folder above and copy it by hand.
